storageTitle: Not enough space for the runtime update
storageShortfall: {{path}} needs {{required}} MiB; {{available}} MiB is available. At least {{shortfall}} MiB more is needed.
storageAction: Ask an administrator to review storage on this filesystem, then retry. Preserve controller data and the previous runtime needed for recovery.
previousRuntimeRunning: The previous runtime is running. Outputs remain off and the controller stays unavailable until the expected image is verified.
recoveryPending: Recovery is still pending. The controller stays unavailable with outputs off; check the update status before retrying.
unavailableDescription: Check access to Attraccess. Update status will refresh automatically when the connection is restored.
reenrolDescription: This controller has no verified managed SSH identity. Remove it and enrol it again to provision encrypted management credentials for automatic updates. Re-enrolment is destructive and wipes applications, data and configuration on the CC100.
retiredDescription: This enrolment was retired. Its encrypted recovery credential remains available to administrators.
automaticDescription: The server automatically installs its runtime when the CC100 connects with a different image. During the mismatch, outputs are switched off and normal operation is blocked, including after a failed update or rollback.
cleanup: Runtime accepted; cleanup needs a retry after {{date}}.
recoveryDescription: Administrator tools for failed updates or lost update access. Root SSH login is disabled after secure update access is set up. Showing the recovery password does not enable root SSH login.
restoreDescription: Restoring the previous SSH access settings stops automatic updates. Enrol the controller again to enable automatic updates. This action is recorded in the audit log.
actionFailed: Action failed. Check administrator permissions, audit availability and controller access.

failures.transfer_size: The runtime transfer ended early or exceeded the expected size. The image was not loaded. Check the network connection and retry
failures.transfer_checksum: The received runtime bundle failed its SHA-256 checksum. The image was not loaded. Check the server runtime files and network connection, then retry
failures.transfer_timeout: The runtime transfer exceeded the 300-second receiver deadline. Check network throughput and controller load, then retry
failures.receiver_tools: The CC100 could not run the binary transfer receiver with its installed shell tools. Deploy a server build with an FW31-compatible receiver, then retry
failures.management_required: Verified SSH management credentials are missing or unreadable. Open Recovery tools to restore access; controllers without managed enrolment must be enrolled again
failures.offline: The server cannot reach the CC100 runtime over SSH. Check controller power, its saved IP address, network access and SSH service
failures.incompatible: The CC100 platform or installed management helper is incompatible with this runtime. Check the supported CC100 model, WAGO FW31 baseline and managed enrolment
failures.storage: The CC100 has insufficient free space for the new image and rollback checkpoint. Free space on the controller and retry
failures.host_gate: The controller safety check failed. Check that CODESYS and other output writers are stopped and the configured I/O devices are available; retry after resolving the conflict
failures.release_changed: The server runtime changed during the update. The previous runtime is restored and the server retries using its current release
failures.transfer: The runtime bundle could not be transferred or verified. Check SSH/network access and available controller storage, then retry
failures.load: Docker could not load or verify the runtime image. Check Docker and controller storage, then retry
failures.readiness: readiness check failed: the new runtime did not report a fresh connection and valid configuration from the expected image. Check MQTT access, configuration and hardware diagnostics, then retry
failures.interrupted: The update was interrupted before it could be confirmed. The server will recover the transaction and retry; check controller and server connectivity
failures.recovery: The previous runtime could not be restored. Outputs remain blocked. Open Recovery tools and restore controller access before retrying
failures.host_identity: The SSH host key no longer matches the enrolled CC100. Verify the controller identity and saved IP address before restoring managed access
failures.authentication: The CC100 rejected its saved management SSH key. Open Recovery tools to repair managed access
failures.ssh_agent: The server could not start or use its SSH authentication agent. Check that ssh-agent and ssh-add are installed and available to the server process
failures.audit: The server could not record the required update audit entry or recover its initiating administrator. Restore audit availability and verify the enrolment record before retrying
failures.runtime_assets: This server build has missing or invalid CC100 runtime assets. Deploy a server build containing the runtime bundle, checksum and release descriptor, then retry
failures.unknown: An unrecognized update failure occurred. Outputs remain blocked. Check the server update logs and controller diagnostics; contact support with the update phase and failure code
failures.codesys_active: CODESYS is still running and may control the outputs. Stop CODESYS before retrying the runtime update
failures.codesys_boot_enabled: CODESYS is configured to start at boot. Disable its boot entry before retrying; stopping the current process alone is insufficient
failures.io_unavailable: An expected I/O register or serial device is missing, or runtime access permissions could not be verified. Check the hardware profile, device paths and runtime user permissions
failures.writer_conflict: Another process or container can write to the outputs, or the runtime container identity is inconsistent. Stop the conflicting writer and verify the enrolled container before retrying
failures.lock_tools: The installed SSH management scripts use a lock option unsupported by this CC100 firmware. An administrator must repair the scripts through the controller console or restore root SSH access before automatic setup can continue.

stateDescriptions.pending: Managed SSH enrolment has not finished. Resume commissioning to provision and verify the update credentials.
stateDescriptions.verified: The update access key is verified. The server automatically secures SSH access once the controller is connected, its configuration is applied and runtime readiness is confirmed. No manual continuation is required.
stateDescriptions.recovery_required: Saved management credentials are unreadable, or SSH enrolment/cutover could not be verified. Open Recovery tools and retry managed access; the runtime remains blocked until its image matches the server.
stateDescriptions.retiring: Automatic updates are being disabled. Finish restoring the previous SSH access settings before enrolling this controller again.

progress.staging: Checking the controller and loading runtime…

setup.connection: Waiting for a fresh connection from the CC100 using its permanent MQTT credentials. Check controller power, network access and its MQTT connection. Setup resumes automatically when it connects.
setup.runtime_state: The CC100 is connected, but the server has no fresh runtime status for this connection. Check the runtime diagnostics and MQTT connection. Setup resumes automatically when status is received.
setup.enrollment_credentials: Waiting for the temporary MQTT enrolment credentials to be revoked. The server handles this automatically. Open Setup progress for commissioning details if this persists.
setup.configuration: The CC100 has not confirmed an applied configuration. Select Configure, review and publish the inputs and outputs configuration, and resolve any rejection shown there. SSH setup resumes automatically after the controller confirms it.
setup.readiness: The CC100 has not passed its runtime readiness checks. Click Configure to inspect diagnostics and resolve the reported configuration or I/O faults. SSH setup resumes automatically when the checks pass.
setup.session: The saved commissioning session is missing or does not match this controller. An administrator must check the enrolment records; SSH setup cannot finish automatically in this state.
setup.server_setup: The server SSH verification service is unavailable. Ask an administrator to check WAGO plugin startup and server logs. This service must be restored before SSH setup can finish.
setup.scheduled: All runtime prerequisites are confirmed. The server will complete SSH setup automatically on its next check; keep the CC100 connected.
setup.ssh_cutover: Securing SSH access for automatic updates…
setup.reboot: Rebooting the CC100 and checking secure update access…
setup.unknown: Automatic SSH setup is waiting for an unrecognized prerequisite. Ask an administrator to inspect the commissioning details and server logs.
setup.preparation: Checking the installed runtime and waiting for controller operations before securing update access…
